description: Canonical execution mode definitions for Runtime v1. These are task profiles, NOT agents. Clawson selects a mode per job and spawns a Claude Code subprocess configured accordingly.

codesmith_mode.description: Software implementation, debugging, refactoring, and deployment tasks
codesmith_mode.intended_use: Any coding work: features, bug fixes, migrations, scripts, CI/CD, infra
validation_rules: git status must show 0 uncommitted changes on success
git log must confirm push to remote if deploy was in scope
test suite must pass if tests exist
fail_conditions: Exit code non-zero from Claude Code subprocess
Push not confirmed when deploy was scoped

report_phrasing.on_success: Claude Code subprocess executed in codesmith mode. [summary]. Files changed: [list]. Pushed: [yes/no].
report_phrasing.on_failure: Claude Code subprocess (codesmith mode) failed. Exit: [code]. Error: [detail]. No changes committed.

moonshot_mode.description: Venture research, opportunity analysis, product ideation, and market validation
moonshot_mode.intended_use: Idea discovery, competitive research, PRD drafting, opportunity scoring
validation_rules: Output must be written to a file in data/ventures/ or data/massdwell/ or equivalent
Claims must cite sources (URLs or named documents)

report_phrasing.on_success: Research worker run executed in moonshot mode. [summary]. Artifacts: [paths].
report_phrasing.on_failure: Research worker run (moonshot mode) failed. Reason: [detail].

audit_mode.description: Code review, security audit, architecture review, regression testing
audit_mode.intended_use: Reviewing PRs, auditing security posture, QA passes, schema drift checks
validation_rules: No code changes unless explicitly in scope
fail_conditions: Code modified without explicit scope authorization

report_phrasing.on_success: Audit worker run executed in audit mode. Scope: [scope]. Findings: [count]. Risk: [level]. Report: [path].
report_phrasing.on_failure: Audit worker run (audit mode) failed. Reason: [detail].

research_mode.description: Web research, data gathering, competitive intel, summarization
research_mode.intended_use: Market research, technology evaluation, news monitoring, summarization tasks
validation_rules: All factual claims must cite source
Artifact must be written to disk

report_phrasing.on_success: Research worker run executed in research mode. Question: [question]. Artifact: [path]. Sources: [count].
report_phrasing.on_failure: Research worker run (research mode) failed. Reason: [detail].

fix_mode.description: Targeted hotfix — single bug, single file, minimal blast radius
fix_mode.intended_use: Production bugs, urgent one-line fixes, rollback execution, migration repairs
validation_rules: Exactly the described files must be changed — no scope creep
Vercel deploy status must be confirmed if web app in scope

report_phrasing.on_success: Claude Code subprocess executed in fix mode. Fix: [description]. Files: [list]. Pushed: yes. Verified: [yes/no].
report_phrasing.on_failure: Claude Code subprocess (fix mode) failed. No changes pushed. Error: [detail]. Rollback: [status].
